title: Create a system-versioned temporal table
contentRelevance: The current creation article requires temporal history to match current-table column count, names, order and types. History cannot have a primary key or unique index. Skipping temporal data consistency checks does not waive those schema requirements.

parents.evidenceSummary: The frozen specialized-table training unit explicitly links the former creation article. New HTTP GET receipts show that both the legacy citation and the actual azure-portal training link redirect to the /tables/temporal/create article; the final sql-server-ver17 selector is a same-document presentation view. The query-free canonical article was independently retrieved through Microsoft Learn MCP.
parents.relevanceJustification: The canonical article is the observed redirect successor of the exact creation reference in credential-linked training. Its current-table/history schema rules and user-defined-history restrictions directly support the existing specialized-table candidate, without a doc-to-doc provenance chain.
